## Scope
Describe what changed and the GitHub issue it resolves.

## Ownership
- [ ] Gemini-built feature
- [ ] ChatGPT-built feature
- [ ] Human change

## Architectural regression checklist
- [ ] Doors remain correctly aligned (living/kitchen: 70+70 cm)
- [ ] Living room and kitchen have no additional access doors
- [ ] Windows unchanged except as explicitly requested
- [ ] Stair geometry and side-door access unchanged except as explicitly requested
- [ ] 2D and 3D are synchronized when editing geometry

## Testing
- [ ] JavaScript syntax/HTML checks
- [ ] Startup in real browser (not only a mocked WebGL environment)
- [ ] Mouse drag, keyboard controls, undo and redo
- [ ] Save and reopen JSON
- [ ] Screenshot of the affected 3D view attached
- [ ] Mobile viewport checked, if affected

## Review result
Explain remaining limitations and untested aspects. At least one independent review is required before merge. **Do not auto-merge.**
